title: Dictionary-side specificity of the dual geometry: pre-registration
status: DRAFT until scripts/freeze_prereg.py --prereg prereg/dictionary_specificity_prereg.json has written dictionary_specificity_prereg.lock.json and both files are committed. Edit only before freezing.
relation_to_thesis: Added after the two-tail, word-level, continent and causal results were known. Acharya et al. (2026) define the dual geometry as activation-space concept directions anti-concentrating while unembedding-row contrasts concentrate. word_specificity_prereg.json tested the activation half against a lexical null; this tests the unembedding half against the same null, with the same concepts, basis, Gini and statistics. Changes nothing frozen in any earlier pre-registration. Frozen before any dictionary-specificity output was produced.
claim_tested: Word-pair concept directions built from unembedding rows, mean(gamma(target)) - mean(gamma(base)), sit further toward the high-variance head of the unembedding spectrum than the same difference of means for two arbitrary groups of words of the same size.
why_the_published_check_is_not_enough: The published comparison (scripts/fix_hole5_unembed_null.py) set concept directions against the difference of ONE random token pair drawn from all unembedding rows. That differs from a concept direction in three ways at once: the concept relation, real words versus arbitrary tokens (sub-words, other scripts, padding rows), and an average over n pairs versus a single pair. The primary null below matches the last two and leaves only the relation.
gemma_policy: Same as every earlier pre-registration: every test is reported with and without gemma-2-2b, and a conclusion is called robust only if it holds both ways.
concepts: All files in data/word_pairs/ with at least 4 pairs (42 concepts). Within a model, a pair is kept only if both words are single tokens and map to different tokens; a concept is kept only if it has at least 4 such pairs. No concept is selected or dropped after seeing results.
token_rule: published (identical to scripts/artifact_check_unembed.filter_single_token_pairs): the token of the bare word if it is a single token, otherwise of ' ' + word if that is a single token, otherwise the word is dropped.
word_vectors: gamma(w) = the row of the unembedding matrix for w's token, read directly from the model's safetensors (lm_head.weight, or model.embed_tokens.weight when the embeddings are tied). Before any real run, 'dictionary_specificity.py check' must show that this equals the published route (linear_rep_geometry.get_lm_head) on Qwen2.5-0.5B to within 1e-3; if it does not, every run uses the published route.

primary.basis: published language subset (results/<model>/en-fr/cov_src.pt, or its eigen cache); no fallback to the full vocabulary
primary.null: lexical: 2n words drawn without replacement from the pooled single-token vocabulary of all usable concepts in that model, excluding the concept's own tokens, split at random into two groups of n
primary.statistic: gap = Gini(concept) - mean Gini(lexical null), averaged over concepts within a model; POSITIVE means further toward the head (the direction the published account predicts)
primary.test: one-sample t-test of the per-model mean gap against 0 across models, two-sided, alpha 0.05; Wilcoxon signed-rank reported alongside
primary.equivalence: TOST with bounds +/-0.082 Gini units (the placement bound used throughout the thesis)

inclusion_and_validity.model_inclusion: a model enters only if at least 10 concepts survive the single-token rule
inclusion_and_validity.validity: the primary test is valid only if at least 6 of 8 models enter; otherwise it is reported as not testable and no conclusion is drawn

decision_rule.specific_head: 95% CI of the mean gap above 0 in both the all-model and without-gemma versions
decision_rule.not_specific: TOST equivalent within +/-0.082 in both versions
decision_rule.reversed_tail: 95% CI of the mean gap below 0 in both versions

reproduction_check: Reported first, not a condition for the primary test: the published comparison, concept Gini minus the mean Gini of 1,000 single random token pairs over all unembedding rows (seed 42, as in fix_hole5_unembed_null.py). It reproduces if that gap is positive in at least 6 of 8 models. If it does not reproduce, that is reported, and the primary result is still reported as pre-registered.
secondary_reported_not_primary: vocab_n null: 2n random tokens from the tokenizer vocabulary (padding rows excluded), two groups of n -- separates averaging from real-word structure
repartition null: the concept's own 2n words, random split
per-concept-group means (Verb Morphology, Semantic, Semantic expanded, Grammatical, Language Pairs): exploratory, uncorrected
per-concept permutation p-values: descriptive, compared with the 5% expected by chance

dual contrast: per-model dictionary gap beside the activation gap from word_specificity (language basis, final layer). Descriptive only, because the dictionary side uses the single-token subset of pairs and the activation side all pairs
multiplicity: One primary test. Secondary rows are reported in full and not used for the conclusion.
reporting: The result is reported whatever it is.
